newTabDescription: Choose where new tabs are opened when you create them
matchingUrlsDescription: Match the new tab's URL. The first matching rule wins. Patterns support regular expressions.
matchingUrlsHelp: Default keeps the browser's position. Tab on Activate can override the position when the tab becomes active.
loadingPageDescription: Move tabs when navigating to a matching URL. The first matching rule wins. Patterns support regular expressions.
loadingPageHelp: The destination URL takes priority; server redirects can also match the original URL. Loading rules override initial tab placement. Switching tabs later applies Tab on Activate. Pinned tabs and restored pages keep their positions.
popupDescription: Open pop-up windows as tabs in the last focused normal window.
popupAsNewTab: Open pop-up window as new tab
popupExceptionsHelp: Matching URLs keep their pop-up window. Patterns support regular expressions.
popupHelp: Converted tabs start at the end. Loading Page rules apply on navigation, and later tab switching follows Tab on Activate. Restored pop-up windows stay unchanged.
closingDescription: Choose which tab becomes active when you close the current tab
activationDescription: Move a tab to the first or last position when it becomes active. Pinned tabs stay in place.
invalidPattern: Enter a valid URL pattern for each rule.
saveFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
